claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase.direct_apply
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Healing Word has no attack roll and no saving throw — it directly heals the target with no roll resolution. The activation family concept fits (instantaneous, one-shot cast), but every existing ActivationPhase variant (attack_roll, save_gate) requires a roll gate before the effect fires. A direct_apply (or unconditional) phase variant is needed for spells that resolve to an effect without any die-based gate.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains Hit Points equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Effect.heal_hp
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell Effect union (DamageEffect | NoneEffect) has no heal variant. HealHpEffect exists in ClassFeatureEffect but is not reachable from spell ActivationPhase. Adding heal_hp to the spell Effect type would let the direct_apply phase carry the heal.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains Hit Points equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DiceExpr.statAddend
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The heal amount is 2d4 PLUS the caster's spellcasting ability modifier, which is a dynamic character stat — not a fixed number. DiceExpr.flat is number | undefined (static). To express this accurately, DiceExpr needs a way to reference a named stat addend (e.g., spellcasting_ability_modifier). Without it the modifier component cannot be encoded honestly.
